description: This file is a Node.js script written in JavaScript / ES modules, intended to be executed via Node.js to manage build processes, dependency checks, and runtime execution for a TypeScript and JavaScript project. It includes functions for determining if a rebuild is necessary based on file modifications, git status, and configuration changes, and subsequently runs or builds the runtime environment accordingly.

methods.name: runNodeMain
methods.description: Main function to coordinate the build process, determine if rebuild is needed, perform build steps, and run the runtime process.

methods.name: resolveBuildRequirement
methods.description: Determines whether the project requires rebuilding based on file timestamps, git status, and configuration.
